Let’s take care of our elderly!

All four of my grandparents lived at our house when I was growing up. Three were very sick. I helped take care them.

My mom and dad lived until they were 93 and 95. 

Healthcare, hospitals and growing old can be complicated and I am devoted to help our elderly.

Today, I helped cut the ribbon at @NorthwellHealth Age-Friendly Center of Excellence in Oyster Bay supported by the Glen Cove Hospital’s Geriatric Center for Excellence.

This vital facility, supported by a $2 million federal grant I secured in 2022, brings together a dedicated team to deliver comprehensive, one-stop healthcare for our aging population. My hope is that it, along with the work at the Glen Cove Hospital’s Geriatric Center for Excellence, will become a national model to help our seniors age as healthy as possible.

This is #NationalNursesWeek

My Mom was an RN and worked in the operating room at Glen Cove Hospital. The skilled care and emotional support that nurses provide to patients and their families is unrivaled and deserves our recognition.

To the more than 4 million registered nurses in the US working in hospitals, skilled nursing facilities, physician offices, community health centers, schools, home health, hospice, or outpatient settings, and the millions more that came before them, including my Mom, thank you for all that you do and continue to do!

1.    Cuts to Healthcare
It slashes Medicaid funding—putting health coverage at risk for millions of families.

29% of the children in my district count on Medicaid. These proposed cuts would crush our neighbors, hospitals, and health care providers. Listen to these interviews and decide whether unnecessary tax cuts for the wealthiest Americans and massive deficits are worth the cost. https://t.co/ybsUV15Md9

The President and Vice President are once again,spreading a false narrative. Democrats aren’t fighting for undocumented immigrants’ to receive healthcare — we’re fighting to protect coverage for over 4 million hardworking American citizens and prevent massive premium hikes for millions more.

It’s now the 8th day of the government shutdown. Democrats and Republicans must come together to reopen the government and extend premium tax credits that help lower health care costs. These credits make coverage more affordable for millions. We need action now. https://t.co/1v95mR3P8E

Danny Tsoi, a Marine veteran, is a hard working furloughed federal employee (25% of federal employees are veterans). Danny is fighting for lower healthcare costs and for the government to reopen. He wants to do his job and get his paycheck. Let’s listen to Danny. Reopen the government and extend the premium tax credits.

Let’s not fall for any of Donald Trump’s distractions. We need to reopen the government, lower healthcare costs and focus on the issues the American people care about. The economy, immigration, taxes, crime and healthcare. https://t.co/Inb1qwAcV0

Democrats and Republicans need to find a way to trust one another. The majority of both Democrats and Republicans want to reopen the government and lower healthcare costs. Let’s do it. https://t.co/FLq1ciNr8T

All across America families are receiving notice that their healthcare costs are skyrocketing. We need to fix this. Reopen the government. Extend the premium tax credits. Now. https://t.co/yJJHEUXHoD https://t.co/lX8aNbj90n
